description_policy: Descriptions are paraphrased capture summaries, not verbatim source text. description_raw is null.
tag_policy: Page-level tags remain separate. Only explicit per-skill list entries and inline section tag prefixes are attached. Null tags mean no section-level mapping was recorded in this batch.

sections.name: Piercing Onslaught
sections.description_summary: Performs three charges along different straight paths, damaging and stunning enemies; the final charge crosses the battlefield and ends with Ride Down.

sections.name: Gallant Charge
sections.description_summary: Opening Ride Down charges through enemies, pushing the first target struck; a target pushed to the edge is knocked airborne and down. Active cast sweeps the lance against adjacent enemies.

sections.name: Lance Flurry
sections.description_summary: Performs rapid lance strikes that reduce the target's ATK for 12 s; damage increases when Estrilda is at the enemy edge.

sections.name: Hero Focus
sections.description_summary: Increases ATK.

sections.name: Pennon of Valor
sections.description_summary: When Ride Down reaches the enemy edge, plants a pennon that buffs allied ATK and reduces damage taken. Higher rank marks the pushed enemy to take increased damage.

sections.name: Enhance Force
sections.description_summary: After Piercing Onslaught, heals and shields Estrilda; after Ride Down, grants Penetration and ATK.

sections.name: Season Charm
sections.description_summary: Estrilda's own-skill displacement grants ATK; higher ranks also grant a shield.

sections.name: Rivalry Mode
sections.description_summary: Provides separate opening/assist/defeat stats and refine effects.

sections.name: Dominance Ring
sections.description_summary: Begins with 1000 Energy. Challenges one adjacent enemy and immobilizes them; creates a hunting circle around Kordan and the target. Units inside take reduced damage/healing from outside sources; allies inside gain ATK, Life Drain and damage dealt.

sections.name: Fury Slash
sections.description_summary: A sweeping slash damages an enemy and grants Kordan a shield based on damage dealt plus ATK.

sections.name: Sundering Strike
sections.description_summary: Leaps and slams an enemy, dealing damage and knocking them down.

sections.name: Hero Focus
sections.description_summary: Increases ATK.

sections.name: Rage Unleashed
sections.description_summary: After the first assist/defeat in the hunting circle or after 20 s fighting inside it, Fury Slash and Sundering Strike are enhanced. Later levels grant permanent DEF stacks and healing after assists/defeats.

sections.name: Enhance Force
sections.description_summary: Assists/defeats inside the hunting circle make Kordan leap to a new target and reposition the circle; extends its duration and grants allies inside Penetration.

sections.name: Season Charm
sections.description_summary: Reduces damage taken per adjacent enemy; higher ranks periodically damage nearby enemies and reduce their ATK.

sections.name: Rivalry Mode
sections.description_summary: Provides a separate timed defensive/offensive effect and refine stats.

sections.name: Tempest Thrusts
sections.description_summary: Performs eight piercing strikes in a frontal area, each with current-HP-based extra damage, followed by a charge; Sonja is control-immune while casting.

sections.name: Crimson Covenant
sections.description_summary: Opening link with two allies to her left and right, increasing their ATK and Phys/Magic DEF. Bonuses grow over time. If a buffed ally is defeated, the covenant ends and Sonja absorbs accumulated stats.

sections.name: Stunning Reception
sections.description_summary: Spins and slashes nearby enemies twice, stunning them.

sections.name: Hero Focus
sections.description_summary: Increases Haste; grants extra Haste after the first Ultimate.

sections.name: Unbreakable Bond
sections.description_summary: Grants Initial Energy and improves Crimson Covenant so Sonja benefits from accumulated bonuses while buffed allies remain alive. Higher levels share damage reduction among covenant members.

sections.name: Enhance Force
sections.description_summary: Converts part of Tempest Thrusts damage into self-healing.

sections.name: Season Charm
sections.description_summary: Every 8 s increases ATK and Life Drain for nearby allies; higher ranks add a shield for Sonja per ally affected.

sections.name: Rivalry Mode
sections.description_summary: Provides a separate timed defensive/offensive effect and refine stats.

sections.name: Swift Shift
sections.description_summary: Switches between Skyblaster Mode (shooting/stunning the marked enemy at range) and Sword Mode (rushes the marked enemy for true damage and converts normal attacks to melee). Auto mode chooses based on target HP ratio.

sections.name: Notice Beforehand
sections.description_summary: Marks the farthest enemy at battle start, prioritizes them and absorbs Energy per hit. Retargets the farthest enemy in Skyblaster Mode or the nearest in Sword Mode.

sections.name: Checkmate
sections.description_summary: In Skyblaster Mode shoots an anesthetic bullet and reduces Haste; in Sword Mode hits three times and stuns.

sections.name: Hero Focus
sections.description_summary: Increases ATK; grants extra ATK for each non-summoned enemy defeated.

sections.name: Night Maneuver
sections.description_summary: When the marked enemy is defeated, Vala becomes untargetable until all other allies are defeated, gaining movement speed and Haste.

sections.name: Enhance Force
sections.description_summary: Increases damage to the marked enemy. LV 2 marked enemies deal less damage; Skyblaster gains Energy on attack, Sword gains Execution.

sections.name: Season Charm
sections.description_summary: Provides opening damage and Haste; higher ranks restore HP and extend the effect after assists/defeats.

sections.name: Rivalry Mode
sections.description_summary: Provides separate opening/assist/defeat stats and refine effects.

sections.name: Furthest-enemy targeting
sections.description_summary: The page documents furthest-enemy selection and hex-ID tie-breaks; preserved as structured targeting metadata.

sections.name: Grimoire Pact
sections.description_summary: At battle start selects the frontmost ally as companion. Stat boosts received by the companion create permanent spell-note stacks. Ultimate buffs companion ATK/Haste and adds corresponding stats from stored notes.

sections.name: Lingering Grace
sections.description_summary: Heals the companion and damages enemies adjacent to the companion; part of the damage becomes additional healing.

sections.name: Hexward
sections.description_summary: After the companion is controlled for 5 s, makes them unaffected. When an enemy deals enough damage to the companion, reduces that enemy's ATK.

sections.name: Hero Focus
sections.description_summary: Increases Assistance.

sections.name: Retributive Echo
sections.description_summary: Ultimate also debuffs the enemy who dealt the most damage to the companion, reducing stats linked to Isabella's spell-note stacks.

sections.name: Enhance Force
sections.description_summary: Qualifying stat buffs received by the companion grant an extra spell-note stack. LV 2 adds Energy per note and increases each note's stat bonus; if allied Silvina is deployed, she is treated as an additional companion.

sections.name: Season Charm
sections.description_summary: Grants an opening melee-damage buff and ranged damage reduction for the ally one tile in front; higher ranks add Energy on Hit.

sections.name: Rivalry Mode
sections.description_summary: Provides a first-low-HP ally heal/shield and refine stats.

sections.name: Frontmost-ally targeting
sections.description_summary: The page specifies frontmost-ally scan order by row and hex ID; preserved as separate targeting metadata.

sections.name: Zoltraak
sections.description_summary: Moves to the rearmost position that maximizes the number of enemies hit; strikes a 3-tile rectangle for 3 s, dealing damage per second and splitting large true damage among enemies hit.

sections.name: Lightning: Judradjim
sections.description_summary: Opening concealment makes enemies less likely to target Frieren. At 15 s, amplifies magic power, increases damage, replaces the normal attack and changes target priority. Fighting with Himmel for 5 s immediately triggers amplification and grants permanent ATK based on Himmel's initial ATK.

sections.name: Hellfire: Vollzanbel
sections.description_summary: Damages the target and adjacent enemies, burns the area for 5 s, causing HP loss and Vitality reduction. Cooldown is halved after magic amplification.

sections.name: Hero Focus
sections.description_summary: Increases ATK; grants extra ATK after magic amplification.

sections.name: Defensive Magic
sections.description_summary: Opening defensive magic protects Frieren and the frontmost ally, reducing excess damage above a max-HP threshold.

sections.name: Enhance Force
sections.description_summary: Five seconds after magic amplification, knocks the highest-cumulative-damage enemy airborne and hurls them toward the battlefield edge.

sections.name: Season Charm
sections.description_summary: Provides Energy recovery per second; after three Ultimates adds ATK, with higher ranks adding true damage to all enemies.

sections.name: Rivalry Mode
sections.description_summary: Provides separate Ultimate-triggered damage/Energy effects and refine stats.

sections.name: Frontmost-ally targeting
sections.description_summary: The page specifies frontmost-ally scan order by row and hex ID; preserved as separate targeting metadata.

sections.name: Falcon Raid
sections.description_summary: Opening 1000 Energy summons Elona. Active cast spends Energy to call Elona to attack the current target; Elona remains on the field until Energy is depleted or Bryon is defeated. Later levels improve Elona's attack, Haste and thunderbolt effects.

sections.name: Leafblade Gale
sections.description_summary: Summons four magic leaves to attack the target.

sections.name: Shadow Flash
sections.description_summary: Passive: normal attacks and skills hit twice and absorb Energy. Active cast deals two hits.

sections.name: Hero Focus
sections.description_summary: Increases Haste; grants extra Haste while Elona is present.

sections.name: Tacit Strike
sections.description_summary: Elona counterattacks and stuns when Bryon is controlled or takes a sufficiently large hit. LV 2: the first fatal blow is blocked by Elona consuming Energy; Bryon heals and becomes untargetable temporarily.

sections.name: Rivalry Mode
sections.description_summary: Provides separate normal-attack stacking effects and refine stats.

capture_status_notes: Capture excerpt ends before Enhance Force and Season Charm; recapture the remainder before treating the profile as complete.

sections.name: Brothers-in-arms
sections.description_summary: Calls two hamster friends into battle; Chippy stands on their shoulders to deal damage to an enemy.

sections.name: Take This!
sections.description_summary: Jumps to deal damage to an enemy.

sections.name: Eureka!
sections.description_summary: Normal attacks have a small chance to deal very high damage; cannot crit and can trigger once per battle.

sections.name: Season Charm
sections.description_summary: Deals magic damage to adjacent enemies and heals Chippy; higher ranks add opening unaffected duration.

sections.name: Special Aroma
sections.description_summary: Creates a 2-tile aroma and channels it at battle start. While active, the twins recover Energy and allies in range heal over time. Active cast heals allies and permanently levels up aroma range and Haste effects.

sections.name: Energizing Formula
sections.description_summary: Increases ATK of allies within the aroma and grants the twins additional Energy per non-summoned ally affected.

sections.name: Shadow Reflection
sections.description_summary: Isolated non-summoned enemies lose Energy and create a Silhouette inheriting part of Berial's stats. The Silhouette loses HP over time and attacks only with normal attacks.

sections.name: Enhance Force
sections.description_summary: Increases hiding duration after defeat. LV 2 reduces the per-enemy cooldown for Silhouette summons, increases Energy loss and eventually prevents Silhouettes from losing HP over time.

sections.name: Season Charm
sections.description_summary: Berial's own-skill displacement grants ATK; higher ranks also grant a shield.

sections.name: Rivalry Mode
sections.description_summary: Provides separate opening/assist/defeat stats and refine effects.
